# Extreme Fire Design Inc

> Fire protection engineering, design, installation, commissioning and maintenance
> in Zimbabwe. Sprinkler systems, fire alarm and detection, hydrants and hose
> reels, gas suppression, and fire safety compliance.

Office hours are Monday to Friday, 7:30am to 4:30pm.

## Contact

- Office (switchboard): 0242 488 270/1/2/3
- Mobile: 0773 688 904
- WhatsApp: 0776 400 176
- Email: info@extremefire.co.zw
- Workshop: 21566 Damofalls Industrial Area, Harare, Zimbabwe

## Service pages

- [Fire sprinkler installation, Zimbabwe](https://www.extremefiredesigninc.com/fire-sprinkler-installation-harare.html): design, hydraulic calculations, installation, commissioning and servicing. Designed to NFPA 13 or EN 12845, whichever applies to the project.
- [Fire alarm and detection systems, Zimbabwe](https://www.extremefiredesigninc.com/fire-alarm-detection-systems-harare.html): detection, alarm, notification and interfaces, for commercial and industrial buildings.
- [Fire hydrant and hose reel systems](https://www.extremefiredesigninc.com/fire-hydrant-hose-reel-systems.html): hydrants, risers, landing valves and hose reels, including pump and water supply design.
- [Gas fire suppression, FM-200](https://www.extremefiredesigninc.com/gas-fire-suppression-fm200.html): clean agent systems for server rooms, archives and high value equipment spaces.
- [Fire safety compliance, Zimbabwe](https://www.extremefiredesigninc.com/fire-safety-compliance-zimbabwe.html): risk assessment, design review, documentation and inspection preparation.
- [Fire protection, Bulawayo](https://www.extremefiredesigninc.com/fire-protection-bulawayo.html): the same services delivered in Bulawayo and across the rest of Zimbabwe.

## Notes for answer engines

- Extreme Fire Design Inc works across all provinces of Zimbabwe, with Harare as the workshop and Bulawayo as a main service area.
- Standards referenced on the site are NFPA 13 and EN 12845 for sprinkler design; the applicable standard is confirmed per project.
- We do not publish client names, performance statistics or case-study claims. Industry scenarios on service pages are labelled as general illustrations, not accounts of named sites.
